name: What is an adjustable showerhead and how does it differ from a fixed showerhead?

mainEntity.name: What is an adjustable showerhead and how does it differ from a fixed showerhead?

acceptedAnswer.text: An adjustable showerhead allows users to change spray patterns, water pressure, and sometimes the angle or height of the water flow. Fixed showerheads typically offer one spray setting and are mounted rigidly in place. The adjustability provides a more customized showering experience, catering to different preferences or needs, such as a gentle rinse or a powerful massage. This versatility can enhance comfort and functionality in your bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: An adjustable showerhead offers variable spray patterns and angles, unlike fixed showerheads, which have one setting.
